title: Don't bother!
text: Don't bother!. I was so looking forward to this.  I was also so disappointed as the mechanism that makes the snow whirl has a loud growl to it and slowly the "snow" would settle to the bottom.  It's hard for me to send things back, so I'm out $!  It was beautiful but sadly didn't work.  It actually looked like a previous return by the box in came in.....dirtyish and a bit worn-looking.

product_metadata.title: Kurt S. Adler Kurt Adler 9-Inch LED Santa Lantern with Motion Table Piece, Multi
features: Made Of Plastic, Water, And Resin
description: This 9-Inch LED Santa Lantern with Motion from Kurt Adler is a charming addition to any holiday décor. This lantern features a black, rustic base with Santa riding a reindeer. When switched on, a spotlight falls on Santa and glitter twirls around for a snowy scene.
